title: Overview
description: Create is a Minecraft modification that reimagines automation through the use of Rotational Force, supplementing traditional redstone systems with a visually intuitive mechanical power network. Players generate and transmit kinetic energy to drive machines that move items, process materials, and construct dynamic contraptions. The mod also introduces fluid handling, enabling the transport and transformation of liquids using animated pumps, pipes, and spouts. A standout feature is its realistic train system, which allows players to build steam-powered locomotives, schedule routes, and transport goods or passengers across vast distances. To support learning and experimentation, Create integrates with the Just Enough Items (JEI) mod, providing in-game access to crafting recipes, machine usage, and sequenced assembly steps.
